show_hn.story_text: On October 26, OpenAI announced a claimed "bare existence" proof in Balaban's RG programme on pure R^4—but notably stopped right before claiming the mass gap Δ > 0. In the tradition of Gödel and Turing, it proves that demanding BOTH the full Osterwalder-Schrader/Wightman axioms AND a strict spectral gap Δ > 0 on non-compact R^4 is a structural contradiction. show_hn.story_text: Hey everyone! @mozgiii and I have been working on Waymark for the better part of the last year. Waymark’s an open source durable execution library with similar functionality to Temporal or DBOS. A few unique design decisions: — Write jobs in normal code (right now Python but JS coming soon). Instead of running control flow as-is, which requires booting up an interpreter to replay past state, we’ll just compile your code directly. show_hn.story_text:
Hey HN! I've been working on cppbolt, a lightweight C++ to WebAssembly compiler written in Rust. The idea was to build something that can compile and run C++ directly in the browser without downloading a massive LLVM/Clang toolchain. Unlike projects that bundle LLVM/Clang and can require 100+ MB of compiler assets, cppbolt's compiler payload is around 1 MB. It compiles a supported subset of C++17 directly to standard WebAssembly binaries. Some things it supports:
- Classes, inheritance, virtual functions and operator overloading
- Templates and a subset of the C++ standard library
- Pointers, references, arrays and dynamic memory

show_hn.story_text: Spindle is a multicore-by-design, eio-native web framework for modern OCaml. Its central idea is to provide an expressive, type-driven API and derive the rest: codecs, request validation, OpenAPI spec and frontend schemas (Zod and Melange). This keeps contracts in sync between server and client without maintaining separate definitions. The framework includes an RFC-strict HTTP server, composable dependencies, WebSockets, SSE and high-level primitives for building MCP servers. It also provides production-ready essentials like distributed tracing, OT-compatible metrics, logging and other features you would expect.
